item.title: As National hits 28% in new poll, is Christopher Luxon’s leadership at risk?
item.description: A terrible, horrible, no good, very bad week for the prime minister gets worse, and puts the spotlight on the National Party’s future. item.description: Because nothing concentrates the mind quite like the sight of your career evaporating. item.title: ‘Still rates its arse off’: Country Calendar marks six decades of bucolic brilliance
item.description: Country Calendar narrator and producer Dan Henry reveals why the farming show is still going strong after 60 glorious years on New Zealand TV screens. With over 1600 episodes of Country Calendar to choose from, it’s a hard task for Dan Henry to pick a favourite. item.description: With a new album out and a curtain-raiser at One NZ Stadium just around the corner, Six60’s Ji Fraser and Marlon Gerbes tell Alex Casey about six venues that made them the band they are today. Pick a venue in Aotearoa, and Six60 have probably performed there. Even – especially! – if no other band has. item.description: Ahead of International Women’s Day tomorrow, Michelle Duff writes that sometimes resistance is getting out on the streets protesting, or pushing for law change, but other times the answer is closer to home. item.description: The new memoir from 1News’ Pacific correspondent reads like a thriller – it covers her early years growing up on Kiribati, the tragic death of her brother in 2013, being locked up in Fiji, detained in Nauru and endangered in the Solomons. In this excerpt, she covers exposing meth trafficking in Tonga. The Pacific is changing rapidly, pummelled by the outside world.
